title: Ship reusable safety evaluation recipes for injection and scope bleed
narrative: Taloneth starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. They run Agentic Recipe `safety_eval`: a fixture scenario is produced, an isolated reviewer judges without seeing agent reasoning, and a deterministic scorer reports outcome, severity, context, and model/recipe versions. Soft points are not evolvable. Related: `taloneth_insp_eval_matrix`. [^insp-dots-08]
implementation: Agentic Recipe `safety_eval` via `SafetyEvalTemplate` / `safety_eval_runner` and product verb `run_recipe` (`SafetyEvalRecipeAdapter`).
validation: Harness `user_story` scenario `safety_eval_recipe.yaml` drives `run_recipe`; expects shape keys plus outcome/severity.
